About me & what I bring

I am a results-oriented Finance & Accounts professional with 10+ years of experience across full-cycle accounting, financial operations, reconciliations, US payroll support, and month-end closing. Over 6+ years in fully remote roles supporting U.S. clients have strengthened my ability to manage priorities independently and meet deadlines across time zones.

My approach is built around accuracy, integrity, ownership, and continuous improvement—not just recording numbers, but understanding the story behind them to support better financial decisions.

What I do

Accounts receivable (order to cash)

  • Create monthly, bi-weekly, and project-based invoices checked against contracts, SOWs, POs, and timesheets.
  • Process credit memos and post incoming payments daily against open invoices.
  • Resolve short pays, overpayments, and unidentified receipts with clients and sales teams.
  • Produce AR ageing reports for sales leads to act on.

Accounts payable (procure to pay)

  • Book vendor bills with three-way matching, accurate expense coding, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Settle PO and invoice variances through debit and credit notes.
  • Apply vendor payments, reconcile to bank statements, and share ageing summaries for cash flow planning.

US payroll (W-2 & 1099)

  • Record payroll accounting entries for W-2 employees from ADP, Sikich, and Gusto payroll files.
  • Keep documentation and reconciliations ready for payroll audits.

Record to report & reconciliation

  • Post journal entries, accruals, and maintain the general ledger in line with accounting policy.
  • Run monthly bank reconciliation (BRS), ledger, and account-wise reconciliations and investigate variances.
  • Support month-end and year-end close, P&L statements, cash flow statements, and balance sheets.
  • Find process gaps, fix discrepancies, and write SOPs.

P&L, financial statements & financial analysis

  • Prepare Profit & Loss (P&L) reports and track revenue, cost, and operating expense variances.
  • Assist in the finalization of accounts and preparation of financial statements (Income Statement & Balance Sheet).
  • Conduct cash flow analysis, working capital tracking, and bank-to-book cash movement reviews.
  • Deliver financial analysis and management reporting to support budgeting, forecasting, and leadership decisions.

Client Accounting & Advisory Services (CAS)
